question.question: How does Alliance train officers and organize, and what does losing a base do to supporters/officers?

expected.expected_answer: Train in Daylight spending hand card matching clearing with base to place supply warrior as officer. Evening has up to number-of-officers military actions; Organize removes own warrior from unsympathetic clearing to place sympathy and score uncovered points. Losing base discards all supporters matching its clearing including birds, removes half officers rounded up; if no bases remain discard supporters down to five.

source_passages.quotation: - **Train during Daylight:** Spend a **hand card** matching a clearing with a base to place one supply warrior in Officers box. Supporters cannot pay Train. Each officer allows one Evening military operation; taking operations does not consume officers.

**Evening:** The four military operations are **Move, Battle, Recruit and Organize**. Take **up to your number of officers** in operations, in any order and repetition. Officers stay on the board; taking an operation does not consume an officer. After operations, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard hand down to five.

| Military operation | Procedure for one operation |
|---|---|
| Move | Take one move using normal movement rules |
| Battle | Initiate one battle |
| Recruit | Place one warrior at one clearing with a base |
| Organize | Remove one Alliance warrior from an unsympathetic clearing; place sympathy there; score the uncovered VP |

Organize spends no supporters and has no sympathy-adjacency requirement or Martial Law cost; it still needs legal token placement. **After operations**, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard hand down to five.

**Losing a base:** Discard all supporters matching its clearing **including birds**, remove half officers **rounded up**. If no bases remain, discard excess supporters down to five. Do this whenever a base is removed.

answer.ruling: During Daylight, spend a hand card matching a clearing with a base to place one warrior from supply in the Officers box. Supporters cannot pay this cost. Each officer allows one Evening operation, and taking an operation does not consume the officer.

In Evening the Alliance may take up to its number of officers in Move, Battle, Recruit and Organize operations, in any order and repetition; officers remain on the board. One Organize removes one Alliance warrior from an unsympathetic clearing, places sympathy there, and scores the uncovered VP. It spends no supporters and requires neither sympathy adjacency nor Martial Law, but token placement must be legal. After operations, draw one card plus uncovered draw bonuses and discard to five.
Whenever a base is removed, discard all supporters matching its clearing, including birds, and remove half the officers rounded up. If no bases remain, discard excess supporters until five remain.
